messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER: P1 - elevated 5xx/timeouts observed in egress cluster 'egress-west-3' at ~2026-06-12T11:02Z. Auto-runbook triggered: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/egress-retry-spike :rotating_light:

Alex: acked. I'm the on-call. Starting triage. Any customer-facing page?

Maria: seeing spikes in gw_gateway responses -> 502/504 + connection timeouts. Initial metric: 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 9% in ~3m.

Samir: thanks. Correlation samples: corr=3fa7b9c1, corr=3fa7b9d4, corr=3fa7b9f2. Pulling request logs now.

Alex: @Maria @Samir please attach raw request IDs and last upstream host. We need a timeline and whether retries looped.

Maria: short log snip from gw_proxy (sanitized):
```
[11:03:21Z] req=3fa7b9c1 upstream=egress-a1 attempt=1 code=502 latency=120ms
[11:03:21Z] req=3fa7b9c1 upstream=egress-a1 attempt=2 code=502 latency=115ms
[11:03:22Z] req=3fa7b9c1 upstream=egress-b2 attempt=1 code=504 latency=3000ms
```
Looks like retries hit different upstreams and some long tail latencies.

Jordan: building timeline now. Putting aggregated counts into GSheet: https://sheets.internal/r/egress-triage-2069

Kat: uploaded full log bundle to gs://redwood-incident-logs/2069/egress-retry-spike.tar.gz and created a read-only link. Sharing in thread: https://storage.internal/download/2069/egress-retry-spike.tar.gz

Ellie: customer-impact check: flagged 23 customers with request failures >= 3% in window 11:02-11:09Z. Most are dedicated customers in eu-west-1. Notifying account teams.

Alex: mitigation idea: temporarily disable route fanout to egress-b2 and force single upstream path, plus increase gateway timeouts from 30s -> 60s for short window to reduce retry storms. Opinions?

Samir: agree on disabling fanout to egress-b2. Hypothesis: a partial upstream degradation caused gateway retries to fanout and amplify failures. Need to confirm upstream health metrics (conn resets, cpu).

Maria: running quick q to check upstream error rates:
```bash
infra-metrics query 'upstream_errors_total{service=~"egress-.*",region="west-3"}' --start=2026-06-12T11:00Z --end=2026-06-12T11:10Z
```
Prelim shows egress-b2 errors spiked ~11:02Z.

ops-bot: COMMAND: disable-fanout --target egress-b2 --reason "P1 egress retry amplification"
ops-bot: STATUS: success (audit id: a-88c4)

Alex: mitigation applied. Monitoring for drop in 5xxs. Please post updated correlation ids if you still see failures.

Maria: 2m after mitigation 5xx rate dropped from 9% -> 1.1%. Latency p95 improved too. Early evidence mitigation helped.

Jordan: timeline notes appended to sheet. Key events: 11:01Z metric alert -> 11:02Z retry spike -> 11:05Z mitigation applied -> 11:07Z 5xxs drop.

Samir: collecting upstream logs from egress-b2 and egress-a1, uploading tails to the bucket (path: gs://redwood-incident-logs/2069/upstream-tails/). Will link exact filenames once done.

Ellie: customer comms draft: "We experienced elevated 5xxs due to egress retry amplification affecting dedicated customers in EU. Mitigation applied; impact limited. We'll follow up with RCA." Sending to account teams.

Alex: good. Next actions: (1) Samir to share upstream root cause hypothesis + logs, (2) Jordan to finalize timeline, (3) Kat to snapshot config for gateway and fanout rules, (4) Maria to run post-mitigation regression checks. We'll keep this thread for RCA artifacts and timeline.

Samir: preliminary root cause: intermittent connection resets on egress-b2 (likely network flapping) causing gateway retry policy to fanout. Key evidence: sequence of connection resets followed by immediate retries to alternate upstreams causing broader failure. Attaching packet-level capture excerpt to bucket.

Maria: adding log query used for postmortem (for future reference):
```sql
SELECT timestamp, req_id, upstream, attempt, status, latency_ms
FROM gateway_logs
WHERE timestamp >= '2026-06-12T11:00:00Z' AND timestamp <= '2026-06-12T11:10:00Z' AND status >= 500
ORDER BY timestamp ASC
```

Alex: thanks everyone. I'll start the RCA doc and tag owners. If anything new appears, post here. Otherwise we'll convert to postmortem in ~24h after artifacts uploaded. :thumbsup:
notes: in-thread log sharing, runbook automation, on-call coordination, mitigation applied and verified
